title: Plugin manifest
description: Who a plugin is and what it needs. Carried in the plugin package's dashboard-manifest custom section (specs/002-plugin-permissions/contracts/package.md). Draft of wit/manifest.schema.json.

$schema.description: Lets editors find this schema; the host ignores it.

id.description: Where the plugin comes from: its repository, or local/<name> for a plugin that comes from no repository. Lowercase only.

version.description: The plugin's version, in Semantic Versioning 2.0.0.

author.description: Who publishes the plugin, as shown to the user.

permissions.description: Every capability the plugin may use. A permission the host does not know refuses the plugin; the same name twice counts once, unless one entry is required and the other optional.

required.description: true: the user approves it with every other required permission, or the plugin does not run. false: optional; it starts off, and while off every use answers not-granted.

login_providers.description: Accounts the plugin would ask the user to connect. Shown now; connecting arrives in feature 005.
